ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Site (including its design, look and feel, and all HTML, graphics, text and other materials developed by or for HDI specifically for the Site), (ii) the Content and the Marks, and (iii) all customer, order, transaction and user data collected through or generated by the Site, including customer e-mail lists relating to Deerskin Products (collectively, the "Company Data"). HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in the foregoing. HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing software, hosting platform, tools and know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable license to use, modify and exploit any such HDI materials embedded in or necessary to operate the Site. Nothing in this Agreement shall create joint ownership of, or assign to HDI any right, title or interest in, the Site, the Content, the Marks or the Company Data.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership even though HDI develops and hosts the Site with our Content and collects our customer data, so we have added a clause confirming that we own the Site, Content, Marks and customer data while HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and grants us a perpetual licence to anything of its own embedded in the Site. This reflects our position that we own what we pay for and what we put in, and avoids any joint ownership.
input.summary: Add ownership clause: Company owns Site, Content, Marks and customer data; HDI retains background IP and grants a perpetual licence; no joint ownership.
